item.title: Latin America and the Caribbean advance in eradicating hunger for the fourth consecutive year -UN report says
item.description: IN Latin America and the Caribbean, undernourishment decreased for the fourth consecutive year, according to the 2025 Regional Overview of Food Security and Nutrition: Statistics and Trends released on Sunday. The report states that undernourishment affected 5.1 per cent of the population in 2024, down from a peak of 6.1 per cent in 2020. […]
